summary.zh: 编写、审查和优化 Dockerfile 与 compose 配置
summary.en: Write, review and optimize Dockerfiles and docker-compose files

description.zh: 编写、审查和优化 Dockerfile 与 docker-compose 配置，关注镜像分层、构建缓存、体积和安全性。适合在改容器配置前先过一遍，或镜像过大、构建过慢、配置报错的时候使用。本地分析需要 Python 环境，构建校验需要装好 Docker。
description.en: Reviews and optimizes Dockerfiles and docker-compose configs for layer count, build cache, image size and security. Use it before editing container config, or when builds are slow. Local analysis needs Python; build checks need Docker.
